name: Carver County, MN
findings: Carver County has 305 nonprofit organizations. 153 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 117 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Carver County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 23 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
